method: Bounded public-web search and direct review of public official-channel previews. No authentication, platform API, access-control bypass, bulk content capture, or binary download was used.

sources_checked.result: Two in-window primary publications registered: an edited evening operational update and a losses infographic whose image contents were not transcribed.
Three in-window public aftermath and casualty updates registered, including explicit revision lineage for the Kyiv-region update.

The preview contained real-time alert messages describing directions and movement. These were not registered because they could preserve targeting-enabling operational detail; no safe aggregate summary was visible before the cutoff.
The relevant presidential address displayed 4 August 2026 at 20:03 Europe/Kyiv, equivalent to 17:03 UTC, and therefore preceded the assigned window.
No additional clearly in-window primary item was admitted without overlapping another discovery shard.

excluded_candidates.reason: Real-time alerts described current directions and movement and were excluded as potentially targeting-enabling operational detail.
The displayed publication time normalized to 17:03 UTC on 4 August, before the 18:00 UTC window start.

artifact_capture.reason: No immutable permitted artifact was downloaded. Telegram previews did not provide stable content hashes or edit histories, and the losses infographic was not copied or transcribed.

coverage_gaps: Telegram public previews do not provide API-grade completeness, stable content hashes, or edit history.
Real-time Air Force alerts were excluded for operational-safety reasons, and no safe aggregate Air Force summary was visible before the cutoff.
The General Staff losses infographic was registered only as metadata; its image contents were not captured or verified.
DSNS casualty figures changed across updates and remain attributable official statements rather than assessed facts.
This bounded scan is not an exhaustive search of every Ukrainian government or military account.

follow_up_task_proposals.purpose: Create atomic attributable observations while preserving qualifiers, revision lineage, and the distinction between official statements and assessment.
Search for a later safe aggregate air-attack summary without retaining real-time route or movement alerts.

safety_notes: No precise current positions, movement routes, or active-unit locations were persisted.
Granular frontline localities and active-response facility details were omitted from excerpts and summaries.
No final truth assessment, territorial conclusion, reliability score, or report narrative was created.
